The test image shows many small circular lesions with tan centers and brown rings, scattered across a green corn leaf. This is the characteristic "eyespot" pattern: tan center + brown-to-purple ring + yellow halo. The Eyespot reference (Corn_Disease_10) shows the same distribution of small circular ringed spots all over the leaf surface.
